objects.name: target channel

objects.name: distance mode

objects.name: ranking evidence
objects.notes: deterministic title-form compatibility, document proximity, and score proof

objects.name: feedback
objects.notes: saved or dismissed for user + target + video; exact row is reversible

actions.name: explore
actions.notes: GET form changes target and distance in the URL

actions.name: open video
actions.notes: opens the existing private video detail route

actions.name: save / dismiss / undo
actions.notes: server action writes or deletes one exact feedback row

states.name: ready
states.notes: 24 diversified ranked results and corpus receipt

states.name: no tracked channels
states.notes: link to add a target channel

states.name: target not indexed
states.notes: explain that this channel is outside the bounded test corpus

states.name: semantic unavailable
states.notes: Qdrant outage yields a retryable page notice, never an app crash

states.name: empty
states.notes: no candidate survived the bounded query

states.name: feedback saved or dismissed
states.notes: text and pressed state communicate the persisted choice

recovery_paths.name: Qdrant offline
recovery_paths.notes: keep target controls visible and offer a normal page retry

recovery_paths.name: feedback changed
recovery_paths.notes: press active choice to undo or choose the other state

recovery_paths.name: thumbnail missing
recovery_paths.notes: reuse the existing delegated YouTube thumbnail fallback

permissions.name: tracked target only
permissions.notes: feedback insert is gated by an indexed user_channels existence check

side_effects.name: feedback clear
side_effects.notes: deletes the user's exact target/video row
